sloka: ततः प्रभाते विमले कृत कर्मा नराधिपः ।विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् आजुहाव स राघवम् ॥१-६६-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ prabhāte vimale kṛta karmā narādhipaḥ ।viśvāmitram mahātmānam ājuhāva sa rāghavam ॥1-66-1॥

translations.english: The day dawned bright and clear when the king (Janaka) performed his daily routine rites and welcomed the great Viswamitra with the two Raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana).
